rows.en:
Hey there, my name is Nozomu Kazama.
I'm a third-year at this school, and a real nice guy.
...Still, the seventh one never showed up after all, huh?
That means you can't put together your feature on the school's seven wonders.
Well, it can't be helped.
Just call it fate and settle for six wonders.
To finish things off, I'll tell you a story I've been saving.{p}

...Listen up, and prepare to be amazed.
The truth is, I can see guardian spirits.
You know what a guardian spirit is, right?
I know
I don't know

You don't know?
You don't even know about guardian spirits?
Well, this is a surprise.
I didn't think there were still high schoolers like you around these days.
...Well, it can't be helped.
There's no shame in not knowing.
Though if it were me, I'd die of embarrassment.{p}

Well, I'm one of the chosen, and you're just an ordinary person.
You don't have to die just because you didn't know.
A guardian spirit, you see, is a spirit that protects you.
The more powerful the guardian spirit watching over you, the more blessed your life will be.{p}

But if the guardian spirit you've got is no good...
your life turns out the worst it possibly could.
From a quick look, it seems like someone really amazing is watching over you as your guardian spirit, but...
Well, before I look at your guardian spirit, I'll read your past life for you.{p}So, do you want me to read your past life?
I want a reading
I don't want a reading

Good, good, so you want a reading.
Then kindly choose your past-life reading course.{p}You get to choose from the following three courses.
The Special Course
The Ordinary Folk Course
The Warty Toad Course

Oh!
My dear customer, splendid.
Picking the Special Course... you really do have a discerning eye.
The fee for the Special Course is 10,000 yen.
10,000 yen is a bargain.
It'll show me exactly what you were before you were born into this world.{p}Now then, I'll have you pay that 10,000 yen.
Pay the 10,000 yen
Refuse to pay a whole 10,000 yen
Say you don't have the money right now

...You are a wonderful person.
Right now my whole body is trembling with tremendous emotion.
I'll follow you for the rest of my life.
I'll never, ever let you go.
Heh heh heh...
All right then, let me do your reading.{p}

Hannyara makka, honnyara makka, fundaba dadda, haaaaaaaah!
...I see it.
...I see a color.{p}Now, tell me your favorite color.
Red
Blue
Green
Yellow
White
Black
Something else

Red!
Red is the color of passion.
Amazing.
I feel like I'm starting to catch just a tiny glimpse of your past life.{p}
...Hmmmmm, hmmmmmmm.{p}

Hannyara makka, honnyara makka, fundaba dadda, haaaaaaaah!
...I see it.
...I see a food.{p}Now, tell me your favorite food.
Hamburg steak
Curry rice
Ramen
Katsudon
Sushi
Oden
Something else

Sushi!
Sushi, how extravagant.
Sushi is a special food only the chosen, like me, get to eat.
It's not something commoners can ever have, you know.
...How extravagant.
Even I hardly ever get to eat it.
Well, it can't be helped.
After all, I did take your 10,000 yen.
It's coming, it's coming.
Little by little, I'm starting to see you.
...But it's not there yet.
...Hmmmmm, hmmmmmmm.{p}

Hannyara makka, honnyara makka, fundaba dadda, haaaaaaaah!
...I see it.
...I see a hobby.{p}Now, tell me your favorite hobby.
Watching movies
Sports
Traveling
Reading
Listening to music
Stamp collecting
Something else

Stamp collecting?
Your hobby is collecting stamps?{p}

Ah ha ha ha ha...
That's gloomy.
That's one seriously gloomy hobby.
No, pardon me, pardon me.
People can have whatever hobbies they like.
It was rude of me to laugh.
Ah ha ha.
Someone chosen like me shouldn't laugh at a thing like that.
By the way, I hear the 'Beauty Looking Back' stamp dropped in price?
...Ah, no, I was just a little curious.
It's not like I collect stamps or anything.
If you've got the National Park commemorative stamp series, let's have a little talk later.{p}

Well then, your past life is finally starting to come into clear view, so let's give it one more push.
Now, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a wonderful charm.{p}

Say this charm, and you'll get a more accurate picture of your past life.
And that's not all.
You'll get smarter, and a wonderful romance will come true for you too.
You should chant it at least three times a day.
Ready?
Say it in unison now.
"Kazama is magnificent."{p}Go on, say it.
Kazama is magnificent
I can't say something like that
Ask what it's supposed to mean

Good, good.
You're an admirable sort.
Keep it up and chant it every day.
Now, on to the next one.
Say this right after.
"I respect Kazama."{p}
Ready... go!
I respect Kazama
I'd never say that, not even if you tore my mouth open
You've had enough and get angry

Ah ha ha.
You really are something.
I'm sure you'll make it big, no doubt about it.
Oh yes, it's gradually coming into view.
There's no doubt now.
All right!
Now I can see your past life clearly.
Just now, the image of your past life took solid shape inside my head.{p}

...Hmmmmm.
But this is a problem.
I mean, I don't know what to say.
Should I offer my condolences?
...It's really hard for me to say it.{p}...Do you still want to hear it?
I want to hear it
I'd rather not hear it

...Oh well.
No matter what I tell you, don't get mad, okay?
It's not like I'm making things up, you know.
All right, here goes.
Your past life was........................{p}

No, it's still hard to say.
For now, I'll give you a few candidates, so would you pick one of them?
If you pick the right one, well, I'm a man, after all.
I'll give you an honest answer.{p}Now, pick one of these.
A sea slug
Galapagos lizard
Sea anemone
Anaconda
American crayfish
Giant salamander

...Ding-dong-diiing!
...Sad to say, that's the reality.
Before you were born into this world, you were actually a giant salamander!
...Shocked?
But don't let it get you down.
Giant salamanders are living creatures too.
They say they're delicious to eat, you know.
It doesn't just live, it makes good food too. Quite a great guy, isn't it?
You should be proud that a giant salamander like that was your past life.
Ah, splendid, ha ha ha!{p}

Haaaah.
Whew, I'm tired.
...Oh, I laughed and laughed.
That was quite a fun meeting, wasn't it?
I even got to hear a few little scary stories for the first time in a while, so I'm satisfied.
Well then, the seventh one isn't coming, so let's call it a day here.{p}
Tell him to give back the 10,000 yen
Ask what happened to the guardian spirit story
It's just too ridiculous. Enough is enough: get angry

Huh?
What?
...Oh, the guardian spirit story.
Now that you mention it, I did say something like that, didn't I?
You sure are a guy who nitpicks every little thing.{p}You want to hear about the guardian spirits that badly?
I want to hear it
I don't want to hear any more

Oh, come on.
You still don't get it?{p}

The guardian spirits are right here, aren't they?
...And you know, there isn't necessarily just one guardian spirit.
Now you've got it, right?
...You don't?
The guardian spirits are us.
All of us gathered here are your guardian spirits.{p}

Ahahahahaha...
Ahh, that's hilarious.{p}What's wrong? Why the scary face?
So fed up I'm speechless
That's it. Now I'm mad!

Huh?
Sighing like that...
Was it boring for you?
Don't make that face.
A guy who can't take a joke will never be great.
Oops, I'd better be getting home.
...I had a really fun time today.
This school's a big place.
We may never meet again, but don't forget about us.
...That really was fun.
Ah ha ha.{p}

Uh-huh.
So you know about them.
But tell me, how much do you actually know about guardian spirits?
Have you ever met your guardian spirit?
A guardian spirit is a spirit who protects you, right?
Do you always give thanks to that guardian spirit?
It looks to me like your guardian spirit is a truly amazing person...
Hmm.
Your guardian spirit may be amazing, but you're nothing special.
Oh, right. Let's set the guardian spirit talk aside, and I'll do a past-life reading for you.{p}

What's with that face?
Are you holding a grudge because I said you're nothing special?
Instead of glaring at me, work on being a better man.
You should aim to be a cool guy like me, too.
...Now then, {a}.
A fine man like me is offering to do a past-life reading for you.
What'll it be?
Of course you want your fortune told, right?{p}

You don't want your fortune told, you say?
...Please, stop telling such sad lies.
You don't have to be shy.
The past-life reading comes in three courses.
Pick whichever one you like from these.{p}

Wow...
You want the Ordinary Folk Course?
You sure don't look like ordinary folk to me, though.

Less 'ordinary folk' and more 'ittan-momen,' I'd say.
You're more yokai than human.{p}

No, just kidding.
Please don't make such a scary face.
It ruins those handsome looks of yours.
...That was a joke too.
You're not handsome.
The word 'handsome' exists only for people like me, after all.
Well then, let's begin the fortune-telling.
This Ordinary Folk Course reads your past life by giving you a personality test.{p}

First, take a look at this photo.
There's water in the glass, right?
What do you think this water tastes like?
Answer without thinking too hard.
Put your gut feeling into words.{p}So, what do you think this water tastes like?
Sweet
Spicy
Bitter
It has no taste
I don't know

The water here stands for the world around you.
The answer you just gave is how you feel about the world.
But how you feel isn't necessarily right.
The world is a deep place.
Don't you forget that.
...Hmm, I'm starting to see it.
Your personality.
And your past life...{p}

All right, on to the next question.
Now, take a look at this photo.
This is our school's incinerator.
There's a fire burning in it, see?
...Well?{p}What do you think is burning in those flames?
Garbage
A murdered person
Something disposed of in secret
I can't think of anything

I see...
This incinerator, you see, stands for what's inside your heart.
What's being burned in the incinerator...
People who answer that it's garbage seem pretty normal, right?
But they're not.
Getting rid of garbage shows a wish to deal with things you don't want.
For example, the person you like has a lover, and you want to do something about that lover...
Or you wish a teacher you hate would get transferred away...
Or you want to cut ties with a friend you can't stand.
It's precisely people with a strong urge to do something about those frustrations who answer like this.
This type of person tends to try to make the world move the way they want.
Which means...
Hmm, I'm gradually getting a grip on it.{p}
Your past life was...{p}

...Lastly, take a look at this photo.
This is the view looking down from the roof.
...Well?
Don't you feel anything when you see this?
Remember.
Remember the time you were in heaven.
And before that...
What you were doing in your past life...
Well?
Say whatever comes to mind.{p}You were...
A human
A butterfly
A flower

What nerve, saying something like that.
Even someone as good-natured as me is going to get angry.
You were not a human.
It's true the personality you have now is something you inherited from your past life.
But it's not that the personality of some human in a past life is showing through.
...I'll tell you plainly.

You were a poisonous mushroom growing in the Himalayans.
That's why you've got such a poisonous personality now.
That's all there is to it.
Got it?{p}

Wahahaha☆
...Eh?
There's no mountain range called the Himalayans?
A Himalayan is a kind of cat?
......
Huh?
......{p}

Hmm.
Well, what does it matter?
That fortune did you some good, didn't it?
It was fun, right?
I had fun.
So it's all good.{p}
Ahahahaha...
Get furious
Weep and weep

But Kazama dodged me nimbly and said,
"{a}.
Your reflexes aren't very good, are they..."
Grrr...☆
So frustrating.
Somehow, it's just so frustrating.
What on earth is with this guy...
"{a}, you mustn't get rough with me.
That past-life reading earlier was the real thing.
The truth is, I'm your guardian spirit.
That's why I know your personality and your past life so well.
Got it?"
...
What is he talking about?
What on earth is this guy...{p}

"{a}, I'm not your only guardian spirit.
Everyone gathered here is your guardian spirit.
You see, a single person can have a whole bunch of guardian spirits..."
...That's ridiculous.
Kazama was all smiles.
My shoulders slumped, and I let out a huge sigh...{p}

A murdered person, huh...
You see, this incinerator stands for your heart.
A murdered person means someone whose individuality and opinions have been killed.
Too difficult?
I'll tell you what it means to burn a murdered person.
You want to kill someone's heart and burn it in your own flames.
In other words, you have a desire to make someone do as you please.
Either you're in love, or there's someone you want to be friends with.
Or you want someone to obey you, or you're trying to rise above others...
It's one of those.
But you probably have a hard time turning those feelings into reality.
You've got a cowardly side, don't you?
That's a trait that hasn't changed since your past life.
Yes, I'm gradually getting a grip on it.{p}

I see...
This incinerator, you see, stands for what's inside your heart.
Answering that you're burning something disposed of in secret...
means you've got something you can't tell anyone.
You must have been hiding that secret all along.
And you hope it never comes out as long as you live.
...It probably won't come out.
So go on living your life, keeping secrets from people.
Just like you did in your past life.
Hmm, I'm gradually starting to understand.{p}

...This incinerator, you see, stands for what's inside your heart.
If you can't think of what's in the flames...
it means you don't really know what you want to do right now.
You're just living aimlessly.
Even if you don't mean to, you definitely have that side to you.
And the past life of someone like you is...
Hmm, I'm gradually starting to read it.{p}

So close!
You weren't a butterfly.
Not 'butterfly'... but 'but-elderly'!
That's right, you were the elder of a certain village☆
It seems you were a pretty nasty man in your past life.
And everyone hated you.
The village women especially seem to have found you repulsive.
That's got something in common with you now, hasn't it?{p}

Hahahaha☆
...And so, that's the end of the past-life reading.
Ahahaha, how funny!{p}

See, it's funny, right?
Right...?{p}

You.......................... do you know the word 'humility'?
I think you need that word right now.
How on earth could a lame guy like you ever become a flower?
No, wait, it's the other way around.

How could a pretty little flower ever be reborn as a grubby guy like you?
Ahh.
I'm feeling kind of tired.
I've lost the will to tell your fortune seriously.
But I'll give you a quick rundown of your past life anyway.{p}

...Oh!
Don't ask me how the personality I read for you earlier ties in with a paramecium.
I'm already worn out.
I don't want to use my head any more than this.
Ha ha ha...{p}

Oh, come on.
Don't cry, you're a guy, aren't you?
......
Still, there's something about you I just can't leave alone.
I can't keep quiet anymore.
The truth is, about that guardian spirit business earlier... I'm your guardian spirit.
And not just me.
Everyone who gathered here is your guardian spirit.
You see, a single person can have several guardian spirits watching over them.{p}

Mmm, you're adorable.
I'll protect you forever.
Forever...
"Uh, um..."
I didn't know what to do.
What on earth had gotten into Kazama?
Why was he saying things like this?
Th-this is scary...

"Ha ha ha, you're adorable. Ha ha ha ha ha..."
I-it was getting even scarier...
This might be the scariest of all the stories so far.
Nozomu Kazama...
A dangerous man.
Still, this guy's jokes went way too far.
I didn't want to get too involved with him.

"Ha ha ha ha☆ Heh heh heh heh☆"
Kazama just kept on laughing.
My tears stopped right away.
Because Kazama's behavior was just too ridiculous.........{p}

I see...
So the time has finally come...
I really didn't want to do this reading...
Oh well.
I'll do it for you.
This reading uses a warty toad.
You know Kokkuri-san, right?
The Warty Toad Course is something like Kokkuri-san...
Only instead of a ten-yen coin, you use a warty toad.
A live warty toad, mind you.
You hypnotize it and put it to sleep so it won't move.
Then you call down into that toad the god of warty toads, who rules over every warty toad in the world.
To tell the truth, I had a feeling someone would beg me for this course today.
So I came properly prepared.{p}

...See?
Isn't it small and cute?
This one's still a baby warty toad.
Heh heh heh...
All right, let's begin.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, please come to us.
If you have come, please move to 'Yes'...

Honnyara maka, funnyara maka, haaaaaaah☆
...And so, Lord Warty Toad has arrived.
Now then, {a}.
Is there anything you'd like to ask?{p}

Whoops.
Lord Warty Toad has kindly answered on your behalf.
As expected of Lord Warty Toad.
Lord Warty Toad has read your heart completely.
Oh yes, I forgot to mention.
Each person may only ask Lord Warty Toad up to three questions.
Lord Warty Toad has just answered one...
So you can only ask two more.
Poor you.
But that's fate too.
Say, {a}.
You're a pretty unlucky type, aren't you?{p}

Whoa-ho-ho!
Lord Warty Toad answered for you again!
You really are unlucky.
We'd better hurry up and ask about your past life.
You've only got one question left, after all.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, please answer.
What manner of past life did {a} have?{p}

Hmm.
It seems your past life was a wonderful one.{p}

{a}.
Do you understand what I'm getting at...?
"K-Kazama..."
Kazama came up close beside me.
Then he gently took my hand... and made the sign for money with his fingers.
"{a}, if you hand over the goods, I'll ask Lord Warty Toad for you.
I'll ask to be allowed a few more questions.{p}...How about it?"
Give him money
Don't give him money

I see.
Then I'll take ten thousand yen.
Come along, {a}.{p}Hand over the ten thousand yen.
Give him the money
Don't give him money after all

Ooh-hoo-hoo...
You're a good kid.
All right, I'll ask Lord Warty Toad for you.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, I beg of you.{p}

We wish to know {a}'s past life.
Tell us plainly: what was {a} in a past life?{p}

Ooh☆
Your past life was, of all things, a warty toad☆
The reason you chose the Warty Toad Course was that the memory of your past life made you do it.

Ha ha ha ha ha☆
...Hm?
What's the matter?
You look so dissatisfied.{p}

Listen, this is a great honor, you know.
Your past life came out as a 'success,' didn't it?
That means you lived the finest life a warty toad could ever live.
Isn't that a wonderful story?{p}

Ah, {a}.
You're not allowed to go home.
Not even if your past life was a warty toad.
Ha ha ha...{p}

Hmm.
It seems your past life was a terrible one.{p}

Suit yourself.
Then that's the end of the past-life reading.
I'll have Lord Warty Toad go back home.
Lord Warty Toad, Lord Warty Toad, thank you very much.
Please go back home...
There, that's it for Lord Warty Toad.
Now, let's clean up...{p}

"Wh-, K-Kazama...!"
Kazama suddenly plucked up the warty toad and crushed it in his fist with a wet pop.
Red blood spattered everywhere, as if a water balloon had burst.
"P-please stop☆"
Shocked, I tried to stop him.
Then he wiped the blood on his fingers off on his pants and cheekily stuck out his tongue.
"Look, after you do Kokkuri-san, you get rid of the ten-yen coin, right?
...It's the same with Lord Warty Toad.
It's customary to dispose of the toad you used as the tool once the reading's over."
...Wh-what a horrible thing to do.
I felt sick.
The smell of the toad's blood drifted through the club room.
The toad's blood gave off a foul smell, like rotting kitchen garbage.
"L-let's open a window or something."
When I opened the window...{p}

"Ah, thank you, {a}."
With that, Kazama tossed the warty toad out the window.
Hey, what on earth is wrong with this guy?
Doing something like that seemed like a sure way to get cursed by warty toads.
"It's all right."
Kazama spoke up.{p}

"It's all right, {a}.
No warty toad is ever going to curse you.
Because I'll protect you.
You see, I'm your guardian spirit.
And not just me.
Everyone who gathered here today is your guardian spirit.
Did you know?
A single person can have several guardian spirits watching over them..."
For a while, I couldn't say anything.
This is bad.
This guy is a little unhinged...
As I sat there uneasy, Kazama suddenly burst out laughing.{p}

"Ah-ha ha ha, this is hilarious.
Hey, what's with that face?
Are you scared?
Look, your guardian spirits are on your side.
So there's no need to be scared.
...That face.

Wah-ha-ha-ha☆
Oh, that's too funny☆
The truth is, that toad just now was a toy.
A toy frog that squirts water when you squeeze its belly.
What came out of it was tomato juice.
The club room was hot, so it had gone a bit off and stank, though.
Well? Did you fall for it?"
Kazama was laughing, having the time of his life.
...What is with him?
He'd made a complete fool of me.
I sighed and stared at the table.
Feeling somehow sad.
Holding down the anger that kept welling up inside me...{p}

"Then I'll give you a special discount."
Kazama gave a big smile.
So for now, I decided to hand over a ten-thousand-yen bill and get change back.
And then...{p}

Kazama's eyes gleamed.
"Heh heh heh.
Normally, ten thousand yen plus consumption tax should have come to ten thousand three hundred yen.
But as a special favor, I'll make it ten thousand yen, tax included..."
Hmph.
Wh-what a guy.{p}

Ah!
He'd already put the ten-thousand-yen bill in his pocket!
Grr, grr, grr...
"Heh heh.
Well then, shall I begin the reading?{p}

Hannyara makka, honnyara makka, fundaba dadda, haaaaaah☆
...I can see...
...I can see a color.
Now, tell me your favorite color."
...Oh, what the heck.
I've got nothing left to lose.
If it's come to this, I'll just go through this so-called reading of his.
...What should I answer?{p}

...All right.
You're right, taking money from an individual isn't good.
The newspaper club should cover interview expenses.
I was wrong.
...And so, {a}.
The newspaper club's funds are in that cabinet over there, right?
I'll just help myself to those, then...
"...Kazama."
Maybe he had a point.
As I was thinking that...{p}

Kazama opened the club room drawer without asking and pulled out some bills.
But how did he know where the club funds were?
And on top of that, the drawer should have been locked...
"{a}.
I have spiritual powers, you see.
Heh heh heh, surprised?
Well, now that I've got a ten-thousand-yen bill, shall we begin the reading?"
...What a baffling person.
Had he heard from Hino where the newspaper club's money and key were kept, and then pulled this?
Hmmm...{p}

"What are you thinking about?
I told you, I found it with my spiritual powers."
Kazama said this as if he'd read my mind.
He was more baffling by the minute.
"{a}.
It's about time we began the reading."
Kazama pressed his hands together and started groaning, "Mmm, mmm."
"Okay, here goes.{p}

Hannyara makka, honnyara makka, fundaba dadda, haaaaaah☆
...I can see...
...I can see a color.
Now, tell me your favorite color..."
...Oh well.
I guess I'll play along with his reading.
My favorite color...
Now, what should I answer?{p}

I see, I see.
Blue is the color of the sea.
You could even call it the color of our Mother Earth.
I'm starting to see it, starting to see a little!{p}

Green... the color of plants!
Or else...
There's a third-year girl called Mako Midorikawa...
She's pretty cute, you know.{p}

Yellow, is it!
Yellow is the color of faaaaarts!
...No, just kidding.
Yellow is the color of a warning signal.
Which means...
Your past life...
I-it's starting to rise up through the haze.
But it's not clear yet☆{p}

White, is it...!
White is the color of pure innocence!
It doesn't suit you in the slightest!
But...
Let me read your past life from why you'd like white when it doesn't suit you at all...
Hmmm☆
No good! I have to concentrate harder☆{p}

Black is the color of darkness.
How frightening...

...How foolish.
That color is cursed.
But...
You mustn't give up hope just yet.
I'll give you a deeper reading!{p}

What, there's no such word as 'adulty'?
You're a pretty cheeky one, aren't you?
'Adulty' means 'way grown-up, dude.'
What, 'way grown-up, dude' is dead slang?
......
What a nasty guy.
You're a really nasty guy.
...Mmmm, I'm gradually starting to read it.
The past life of a nasty guy like you was...{p}

I see.
So you like curry.
I suppose you like spicy food.
In that case...{p}

Could it be...
You were...
No, it's nothing.
It must be my imagination.
I hope it is.
I could never tell you a result like this.
...I'll try reading it in a little more detail.{p}

Ramen?
Don't tell me you've never eaten anything tastier than ramen?
...Well, that's a shame.
I'll teach you about some really good food.{p}

Let's see, how about homard lobster, Sunbararian style?
If you like, I'll treat you to it anytime.
On your dime, of course.
Ha ha ha...{p}

Whoops, this is no time to be laughing.
I've got to nail your past life dead-on.{p}

Katsudon, huh...
